eval: (()=>{const r=document.querySelector('#gc-rules').innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ');const pv=[...document.querySelectorAll('#gc-rules .pv')].map(x=>x.title).join('|');if(!r.includes('화 00시 ~ 다음 주 월 24시')||!pv.includes('settlement.period')||!pv.includes('settlement.cycle'))throw new Error('마감 규칙 정책값 '+r+' / '+pv);GC.Policy.set('settlement.receivable_pay_days',10);GC.Policy.set('settlement.receivable_weeks',3);return 'period·cycle 키 · 납부 기한 10일로'})()

(()=>{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device tr')].map(x=>x.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ')).find(x=>x.startsWith('미수금 청구'))||'';if(!row.includes('3주 연속')||!row.includes('청구서 10일')||!row.includes('10/23(금)'))throw new Error('미수금 청구 행 '+row);return row})()

(()=>{const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device .tbl-ev tr')].map(x=>x.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '));const i=rows.findIndex(x=>x.startsWith('정산 이벤트 합'));const j=rows.findIndex(x=>x.includes('고객에게 돌려준 디자인비'));const k=rows.findIndex(x=>x.startsWith('분쟁 조정 청구'));const t=document.querySelector('#gc-device').innerText;const r=document.querySelector('#gc-rules').innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ');if(!(i>=0&&i<j&&j<k)||!rows[i].includes('27,000원')||!t.includes('본사 청구 ‘분쟁 조정’ · 수수료 없음')||t.includes('이 화면은 명세 문장대로')||!r.includes('파트너가 받을 돈(+)만'))throw new Error('중재 판정 줄 순서 '+JSON.stringify({i,j,k,rows,r}));return rows})()
(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('#gc-rules').innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ');if(!r.includes('돌려주지 않은 처음 배송비')||!r.includes('클레임 완료(+) · 파트너 몫'))throw new Error('정산서 규칙 '+r);return r})()

(()=>{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device tr')].map(x=>x.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ')).find(x=>x.startsWith('돌려주지 않은 처음 배송비'))||'';const med=[...document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device tr')].map(x=>x.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ')).find(x=>x.startsWith('중재 판정·조정'))||'';const t=document.querySelector('#gc-device').innerText;if(!row.includes('법률 자문 전 초안')||!row.includes('고객 환불 56,000원')||!row.includes('클레임 완료 +8,000원')||!row.includes('처음 배송비 4,000')||!med.includes('분쟁 조정')||!t.includes('655,000'))throw new Error('처음 배송비 줄 '+row+' / '+med);return row})()

(()=>{const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device .panel')].find(x=>/주차별 정산/.test(x.textContent));const h=p?p.querySelector('.panel-h').innerText:'';if(!h.includes('주 1회: 화 마감 → 수~목 확정 → 금 지급')||!p.querySelector('.panel-h .pv'))throw new Error('주기 표시 '+h);return h})()
